<observations>
Date: May 13, 2026
* 🔴 (07:15) Kitchen remodel budget is $28,500; user wants larger oven space for Italian cooking.
* ✅ (19:35) Countertop quotes compiled and project package sent to user.

Date: May 16, 2026
* 🔴 (16:00) User selected "Sea Glass" backsplash tile and upgraded to a 900 CFM range hood ($2,750).
* ✅ (16:15) Sent quartz windowsill mock-up and scheduled May 19 lighting/ventilation review.

Date: May 19, 2026
* 🔴 (07:10) User selected matte black AquaFlow faucet and teal accent paint; demolition postponed until flooring arrives.
* ✅ (13:20) Permit checklist updated; quartz countertops shipping confirmed for June 5.

Date: May 22, 2026
* 🔴 (08:35) User selected "Honey Oak Classic" flooring (250 sq ft) and "Soft Sand" upper cabinet paint.
* ✅ (12:20) HOA approved remodel permit; electrical rough-in scheduled for June 3 with Marco Ruiz.

Date: May 26, 2026
* 🔴 (09:05) User selected "Cascade Ridge" quartzite edge, "AquaPure 24" sink, and rescheduled demolition to June 20 with Luis Ortega.
* ✅ (13:15) Electrical permit amendment approved; VistaGlide sliding glass pantry panels ordered.

Date: May 30, 2026
* 🔴 (17:30) Cabinet delivery scheduled for July 2, 2026; user added "Vintner 24" built-in wine cooler beside refrigerator.
* ✅ (13:30) Miller & Co. electrical layout updated (GFCI outlets added); "Midnight Slate" quartzite and frosted glass pantry panel ordered.
</observations>

<current-task>
Primary: Managing kitchen remodel selections, material orders, and contractor scheduling (demolition set for June 20, 2026).
</current-task>

<suggested-response>
